title: 1BR Studio Home in Rosemary Beach with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Stay in this 1BR, 1BA Rosemary Beach vacation rental with private beach access, multiple shared pools, and two free beach cruiser bikes. Sleeps 4.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• 2 Free Beach Cruiser Bikes• Clean bedding program• One side of the garage is available for parking (additional street parking on Water St or Georgetown Ave)• High Speed WIFI Internet• Sleeper Sofa • Steps from the Racquet Club and Sky Pool (4 Private Community Pools total)• King-sized bed • Fully equipped kitchen• Short walking distance to North Barrett Square and Main Street • Washer and dryer located in the unit• Small BalconyLife at the beach is relaxed and laid-back, and your accommodations should be as well! Hammock Carriage House offers the perfect place to rest your head after a long day spent at the beach. Retire to this lovely abode for a peaceful night's sleep in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.Located a short stroll from the Sky and Cabana Pools and minutes from the town square, this studio home is quaintly furnished with a king bed and comfortable sleeper-sofa. It also features a kitchen with a full-size refrigerator, toaster oven, four-burner, flat-top stove and a dishwasher. A spacious white bathroom with a shower and bathtub combination is located just off the main room. You’ll also find a separate closet area with a stackable washer and dryer just behind the bathroom.Hammock Carriage House is bright and cheerful with an abundance of windows and a small standing balcony just off the living area. It is decorated beautifully with mixed wood furniture, white linens and pops of color throughout. Wainscot lines the walls and gives the home a polished and sophisticated air.If you’re looking to getaway for a few days in a quiet and lovely home, look no further than Hammock Carriage House. You’ll feel like you’ve stepped out of the real world into a place of leisure and ease. Just pack your bags and we’ll take care of the “R&R!”
